content: Feature Predicates as Anchors for Prediction: Given a black box classifier INLINEFORM0 with interpretable input representation, Ribeiro et al. BIBREF6 define anchors INLINEFORM1 as a set of input rules such that when conditions in the rule are met, humans can confidently predict the behavior of a model with high precision. Since the inputs to the classifier are engineered features with finite ranges,we can obtain sufficient conditions for the prediction INLINEFORM2 in terms of interpretable feature thresholds for an unseen instance INLINEFORM3 . Anchors are found by maximizing the metric of coverage, defined as the probability of anchors holding true to samples in the data distribution INLINEFORM4 , in BIBREF6 .
